messages:
kevin: Quick ping — post-merge smoke for PR #8762 shows a small p95 bump on 8k seq. Can someone take a quick look at alloc thresholds before we start a canary? :eyes:

maria: thanks for the heads-up. linking the perf artifact: https://ci.redwood/perf/8762/bench.html — looks like p95 went 18ms -> 22ms. throughput flat.

oliver: copy. do we have a memory delta or just tail latency?

kevin: mem screenshot attached in the artifact but TL;DR: +120MB on prefill for the 4k/8k mixes, +~3% overall GPU mem usage. not huge but correlated with the p95 bump.

asha: is this the alloc threshold tweak from the allocator PR (threshold=0.65 -> 0.7)?

kevin: yes. PR adjusts the prefill-to-alloc cutoff so small prefill batches get promoted earlier. the intent was to reduce stalls, but maybe it increases small-batch contention.

perf-bot: automated regression check: PR #8762 — p95 +22% on 8k seq (confidence: medium). Canary guard: recommend manual approval if you accept up to +10%.

maria: pinging @oliver @asha for a second opinion. I can run a focused microbench with the old threshold tomorrow AM if you want a diff.

oliver: can you paste the heatmap snippet? a quick look at tail shape will help.

kevin: sure, pasted below:

```
context: 8k seq, 1M tokens sampled
p50: 6.2ms -> 6.3ms
p95: 18.1ms -> 22.1ms
p99: 65ms -> 68ms
mem_prefill: 4200MB -> 4320MB
throughput: 120 req/s -> 119 req/s
```

asha: hmmm p99 mostly unchanged, p95 shift suggests more small spikes not systemic. could be queuing due to earlier allocation. if we revert threshold to 0.65 does p95 go back?

kevin: I ran one quick repro locally with canary config: reverting gave p95 18.3ms. I'll attach the microbench once uploaded.

maria: ok let's delay canary for now. plan: revert allocator tweak in canary branch, run 2k/4k/8k microbench sweep overnight, check mem curves in the morning, then decide.

oliver: agree. also request @asha to add a short note in the PR description about expected mem tradeoff and add the bench links so reviewers don't miss it.

asha: will do. also adding a quick opt-in flag so Dedicated customers can keep the new behavior if they want to trade a bit more mem for reduced stalls.

kevin: thanks — I'll post the microbench artifact here when ready. leaving the PR blocked for merge until we get +2 approvals after the sweep. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: CI job queued: microbench-sweep-8762 (8 configs). ETA ~45m.

maria: thanks. if the sweep shows clean p95 on revert, we can merge the allocator change behind the opt-in flag later.

kevin: noted. will follow up with the artifacts and a short summary.
